title: Convert an ISO timestamp to another UTC offset
description: Implement convert_timestamp(ts, offset). ts is an ISO 8601 timestamp 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS' followed by a UTC designator: 'Z' or '+HH:MM' or '-HH:MM'. offset is the target designator in the same form. Return the same instant expressed in the target offset as 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM' (use '+00:00', never 'Z', in output). Raise ValueError for malformed input, a missing designator, or offsets beyond +/-23:59.
invariants: 'Z' is accepted on input and means +00:00.
The date rolls over correctly in both directions, including month, year and leap-day boundaries.
A timestamp with no designator (naive) is ValueError.
